ImageDescription.value: 'Piața Constituției' (Constitution Square) is one of the largest squares in the centre of Bucharest, Romania. The square is standing face-to-face with the Palace of the Parliament (biggest building in Europe) and it is bisected by Bulevardul Unirii (Union Boulevard) and by Bulevardul Libertății (Liberty Bvd.). The square is one of the best places to organize concerts and parades of Bucharest.
